definitions.aggregation: Unweighted mean and NumPy median; strict improvement uses >0 with no tolerance. Samples share packets and are not independent sequence replicates.
definitions.clean: initial equals GT at previous_end_ms exactly; target is GT at end_ms, so hold includes actual inter-frame motion.
definitions.coordinates: Camera-frame MANO transl x,y,z; positive z is increasing camera depth. Source states are meters, converted to mm after float64 subtraction.
definitions.hold: h = 1000 * (initial[:3] - GT_end[:3]); improvement_over_hold_mm = ||h|| - ||e||; positive is better.
definitions.r: r = 1000 * (pred_delta[:3] - pred_clean[:3]); e = b + r exactly up to floating arithmetic.
definitions.rho_limitation: Historical paired rho compares disturbed output with clean output, not with GT. These recalculations measure actual target error separately.
definitions.squared: ||e||^2 = ||b||^2 + ||r||^2 + 2 <b,r>; terms measured in mm^2. b is repeated for each of 6 perturbations in a scale.
definitions.wrist_equivalence: With fixed beta, wrist J0(beta)+transl implies wrist-error vector equals transl-error vector algebraically. No FK roundoff or vertex alignment is used here.
definitions.wrong_events: ||pred_wrong[:3]-GT_end[:3]|| - ||pred_real[:3]-GT_end[:3]||, in mm; positive means real events better.

limitations: Single seed and 24 fixed clean packets per sequence; not a new full-sequence accuracy result.
N1 is separately trained without observation features; it is not a same-weight test-time ablation.
Old C0 and XDL differ in multiple architecture/training choices; clean bias differences do not identify a unique cause.
Swap/mirror are the existing interventions; neither establishes event-guided recovery on the current model own natural errors.
reproducibility: No timestamp/random sampling/model import/FK/inference/training. JSON has sorted keys. Same input bytes and software produce identical output; software upgrades may change version strings or floating arithmetic. Existing inputs are read-only.
